pristine.sourcePolicy: Repo-authored React declaration probes against the vendored react-alien-signals 0.3.0 surface, including negative controls.

adapted.sourcePolicy: Octane public type probes with matching assertion groups for the @octanejs/alien-signals surface.

permittedTransformations.rule: React probes import vendored upstream/src; Octane probes import @octanejs/alien-signals
Adapted probes may exercise useSignalValue on readable computed signals, matching the documented Octane surface
Matching @ts-expect-error and expectType groups must reject or accept the same shapes on both sides

notes: Upstream ships no dedicated typetest suite; both lanes are repo-authored probes over the pinned runtime surface. Assertion groups are compared one-for-one.
